description: Ministry of Lands - Amedment to the notice published in Gazette Ex. No. 1886/58 of 31.10.2014
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves amendments to regulations under the Title Registration Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains legal modifications to statutory instruments, specifically changing terminology and correcting references in existing regulations. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it deals with regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
